Overview

Genoa is a city in Liguria with a population of 560,000. A historic port city on the Italian Riviera, birthplace of Christopher Columbus, with a sprawling old town and world-class aquarium. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 47.0.
